item.text: {"branches":[{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if independently recomputed fish-caught-per-hour rates do not differ materially between livebait groups after accounting for hours, persons, child, and camper.","hypothesis_id":"H1","intervention":"Compare trips using live bait with otherwise comparable trips not using live bait, standardizing fish caught by total hours.","mechanism":"Live bait increases fishing success, producing a higher fish-caught rate per hour.","mechanism_key":"livebait_increases_catch_rate","predictions":[{"direction":"higher","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait coefficient is zero or negative, or its uncertainty includes no practically meaningful increase.","observable":"Adjusted average fish caught per hour for trips using live bait versus trips without live bait.","prediction_id":"P1","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if the livebait and non-livebait groups have similar adjusted fish-caught-per-hour rates.","hypothesis_id":"H2","intervention":"Compare livebait and non-livebait trips while controlling for hours, persons, child, and camper.","mechanism":"Live bait has little independent effect; apparent differences in total fish caught are primarily due to trip duration and group composition.","mechanism_key":"livebait_no_independent_effect","predictions":[{"direction":"similar","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait coefficient shows a practically meaningful positive or negative difference.","observable":"Adjusted average fish caught per hour for trips using live bait versus trips without live bait.","prediction_id":"P2","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if livebait trips have a higher adjusted fish-caught-per-hour rate rather than a lower one.","hypothesis_id":"H3","intervention":"Compare livebait and non-livebait trips under the same adjustment set and calculate fish caught divided by hours.","mechanism":"Live bait is selected by less productive fishing groups or conditions, yielding a lower catch rate despite its intended use.","mechanism_key":"livebait_negative_selection","predictions":[{"direction":"lower","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait coefficient is zero or positive, or its uncertainty excludes a practically meaningful decrease.","observable":"Adjusted average fish caught per hour for trips using live bait versus trips without live bait.","prediction_id":"P3","value_range":null}]}],"budget_units":3,"question":"How many fish on average do visitors catch per hour, and how do live bait, camper status, group composition, and trip duration influence the fish-caught rate?"}
